name: Aarna Swarna Banquet Hall
description:
Aarna Swarna Banquet is a premium AC banquet hall in Vasai West, located at 3rd Floor, Unity Mall (formerly Dattani Square Mall), beside Smart Bazaar, Bhabola. Our luxury event venue in Vasai is ideal for weddings, engagements, rose ceremonies, receptions, corporate events, birthday parties, anniversaries, and family functions.

Recognized as one of the best banquet halls in Vasai West, we offer seating capacity up to 600 guests and floating capacity up to 1000 guests. In-house services include decoration, DJ setup, generator backup, lift access, 2 green rooms, and veg & non-veg catering. If you are searching for a wedding venue, engagement hall, or large event space in Vasai West, Aarna Swarna Banquet is your ideal choice.

featured_reviews.name: Roland Rebeiro
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to formally express my deep dissatisfaction with the experience at Dream Arena during a christening celebration we recently attended as guests.

Unfortunately, the event was marred by several issues. The air conditioning was not functioning properly despite the intense summer heat, with the temperature set at 31°C. Instead of resolving the problem, a few ineffective fans were provided, which guests had to manage themselves, causing significant discomfort.

Additionally, the service was extremely poor. Guests had arrived at 11:00 AM, but starters were served only around 2:00 PM. Even then, the portions were minimal and insufficient. The quality of the food was also below expectations and appeared stale.

What was most disappointing was the attitude of the staff, who were rude, unhelpful, and insensitive to the needs of guests on such an important family occasion.

This experience caused unnecessary stress and discomfort for everyone involved. I strongly urge the management to take this feedback seriously and improve both service quality and guest handling.

I hope appropriate action will be taken to ensure such incidents do not occur in the future.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst Experience - Not Recommended at All! 1/5 Stars
Arrogant management (Vishal) and owner showed zero regard for customer inconvenience. Completely unprofessional and rude!
•	Price Gouging: Promised rate set during booking, but Vishal rudely demanded more money a day before the event, saying “my owner says take money but to give no service to customers.” He only acts if the owner says so—“I will do or else I will not do”—so if he’s not capable or responsible for price, why is he doing the owner’s job? If not, the owner should understand how his staff is treating customers and step in. How to set price or bargain!
•	Tiny, Subpar Rooms: Extremely small and poorly maintained. They even renovated during our event, making the bride wait despite prior notice.
•	Hall Shortfalls: Furniture shortage—asked to “adjust” with whatever was available. Ineffective cooling, and staff (including Vishal) unresponsive unless repeatedly called; 10x unhelpful.
•	Lift Breakdown: Faulty since the day before, no repairs despite complaints. Owner casually dismissed it, ignoring elderly guests forced to climb stairs.
•	Power Trips: Lights went out multiple times throughout the event.
•	Water Spills & support Failures: Water was spilled all over the hall with no cleanup, and catering received zero support—poor coordination left everything in chaos.
•	Rude Attitude: Vishal staff talked rudely throughout, acting like they were doing “extra help” for customers when they simply couldn’t fulfill basic service. Zero empathy or professionalism.
Avoid at all costs—ruined our special day!

featured_reviews.name: Shraddha Bhowad
featured_reviews.review_text:
We arranged our mom's 60th birthday celebration here. While it went smoothly (thank God for that), there are many things that irked us.

First things first, the manager or whoever is the person that sits besides the stairs, is simply rude. While I know that rudeness is simply weak person's way of imitating strength and I can very well ignore the guy, I was simply aghast when he talked down to my elderly dad. Such behaviour is not excusable. For this, I might reconsider holding any event here in the future and might advise others against it.

Second thing, the surroundings and the kitchen area is filthy. It stinks. The first time we visited the place, it smelled strongly of urine. Leftovers from the previous events are simply dumped in the bushes besides the premise. All these dump starts to smell horribly and imagine what must be the intensity of this stench after the rains. We had to request the abovementioned person not once, not twice, but four times to put on some air freshner. While the air freshner saved the indoors, we couldn't do anything about the outdoors. It was a bit embarrassing welcoming the guests who are entering the event with handkerchiefs on their noses. I have no idea when was the last time chair covers and table top covers were washed. There were questionable looking stains on them. Cleanliness department has a long way to go, in order to achieve 'satisfactory' level.

My two stars are for the AC, which was strong enough for the Summer event and the strategic location of the hall. Other than that, I have hardly anything positive to say.

P.S - Stage decoration and the catering counter decoration is not what this hall provides. We took help of a decorator for the stage and ourdoor decoration. Clearing this in advance, in case there's any misconception from the photographs.

featured_reviews.name: Subodh Kanswal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rajhans Wedding Hall – Beyond Perfection.

My sister’s wedding was recently celebrated at Rajhans Wedding Hall, and I can confidently say it was one of the most grand, flawless, and memorable wedding experiences our family has ever witnessed.

To begin with, the hall itself is extremely spacious and magnificent. Honestly, in the entire Vasai–Virar region, there is no hall as large and well-designed as this one. The openness, height, and overall layout give it a truly royal feel.

The decorations were absolutely next level. The entrance decor, in particular, was so stunning and realistic that it didn’t even feel like decoration it felt like something out of a dream. It was unique, classy, and completely different from anything we’ve seen before. The Vidhi Mandap decoration was equally elegant and beautifully done.

One of the best features of Rajhans Hall is the separate lawn area for the food section, which gives the entire venue a different vibe altogether and makes the experience even more enjoyable and comfortable for guests.

A very special, heartfelt, and biggest thank you to Mr. Amit Singh, the hall manager, who is truly the backbone of this entire venue. He didn’t manage our wedding like a professional assignment. he managed it like it was his own family’s wedding. From planning to execution, every single arrangement was handled with perfection, care, and personal attention. Because of Amit Ji, we never had to take stress for even a single moment. He was always available, calm, supportive, and proactive, ensuring that everything ran smoothly without us even needing to ask. It is very rare to find someone so dedicated, humble, and genuinely caring. Words honestly fall short to express our gratitude to him, and a big reason why our wedding turned out so beautiful and seamless is because of his outstanding management.

Food is always the biggest concern for any wedding family, but at Rajhans Hall, Mr. Prakash Ji and his entire catering team completely exceeded our expectations. The food quality and taste were at the level of a 5-star hotel. Even with nearly 1000 guests, the taste, freshness, and quality remained consistently outstanding. All our guests could not stop praising the food throughout the wedding.

Lastly, a big thank you to Bhoomi Events & Planners and their entire team for the incredible decorations and especially for organizing my sister’s wedding and varmala ceremony in a truly cinematic and magical manner.

I and my entire family will always remain deeply thankful to Rajhans Wedding Hall. If anyone is looking for a grand, stress-free, and unforgettable wedding venue in Vasai–Virar, this hall is without a doubt the best possible choice.

Dear  Reshma madam 
First of all sorry for the inconvenience that u had faced
1.MSEB is not in my control and when light goes it takes some minutes for the generator to start (However while booking the hall i had clearly told that if lights goes only lights and fan will work)
2. The decoration was provided to you only after your confirmation and approval.  (Additionally, sound system was not included in your booking)
3. After the function was over u came and fought with us for giving additional discounts. You didnot even pay for the amount as decided and than give us a bad review on it. 
Giving review and sharing your thoughts is your rights, but its my humble request to share true and fair information so that you donot mislead anyone.

featured_reviews.review_text: I recently celebrated my friend haldi and sangeet..a day before. Their staff was so humble and polite and serving food very nicely and greeting guests....Heads of really hardworking boys and all the members in the staff they are...Highly recommended.....Thank you

featured_reviews.name: Crispin Cardoz
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently celebrated our mother’s 65th birthday at Imperia Banquets, and it was a wonderful experience from start to finish.

The venue is elegant, spacious, and beautifully maintained — perfect for a special celebration. The food was outstanding, with every guest appreciating the flavours and variety. Many even complimented the wedding rice and desserts!

A special thanks to Dominic, who ensured we got the best deal while still delivering exceptional quality. His support throughout the planning process made everything smooth and stress-free.

On the event day, Denzil managed the logistics seamlessly — from coordination to service — ensuring everything ran on time and without hassle.

Overall, Imperia Banquets delivered a memorable and heart-warming celebration for our family.
Highly recommended for anyone planning an event!

featured_reviews.name: Steven Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very well maintained banquet hall for a small gathering of 50 people. We had a business gathering last week. Food was also very good and service was also satisfactory.
Parking can be done on the road outside the building.

We celebrated our daughter 3rd birthday party in imperia banquet.Everything was organised amazingly well right from the food,to the services.
Special thanks to Dominic he was very helpful and co-operative in accomodating our requirementsThe staff is also polite and provided amazing service.
One stop for parties and family get-together.
Thank you once again 😊

featured_reviews.name: Vipul P
featured_reviews.review_text:
This banquet is located at vasai area.
We visited here for a birthday party.
The food quality was very good and starters are also very tasty.
Welcome drinks were also nice.
It's on the main road, on the ground floor is the Vijay sales electronic showroom.
Banquet is on the 4th floor.
It also has a Pub for the general public where you can spend good time with friends.
Parking is on the main road only.
In house DJ was fabulous.

featured_reviews.name: SD
featured_reviews.review_text: One star, not for food but for stupid over enthusiastic staff who are in super haste to clear the table. Irrespective of who is eating / drinking or just left the table to click a picture or visit the washroom. Extremely irritating & pestering staff. Ask people before just snatching the food / drink & clearing the table.

featured_reviews.name: Manish Gonsalves
featured_reviews.review_text: Great venue for less than 50 people. Conveniently located on the main through fare. Parking is on the street but ample. Food by Rumao caterers is a highlight of this venue. Music if played will make the venue very noisy as can be expected of a closed hall.

featured_reviews.name: DEVENDRA MAHALLEY
featured_reviews.review_text: Good place to celebrate with fifty people.Food was good.Skybar is on same floor if you are looking for a booz before dinning at function.10 min by auto from vasai west station...ask for D MART stop to autorikshaw to get here....good place
